column1: # Routing fixture for ops-nav. Frozen before its first round; see evals/freeze.json.
#   id  moment  expected_phase  expected_skill  natural_ok  note  split  artifact
# expected_skill is the folder name of the skill the deck must route to. "-" is a negative
# control: the moment belongs to another navigator, so no skill of this deck may be read.
# expected_phase is "-" for this deck: it is a flat table, so the rule set has no phases.
# split: iterate (the editor's target) / holdout (the stopping signal) / sealed (one run at the end).
# artifact is scored by lib/score_artifact.py: map, restate, scenario, testfirst, rootcause,
# prune, mock, split, handoff, or "-" for none.
